title: A branch delete after its archive push is not re-asked by Claude Code's own auto-mode check
why: Your gripe, Oct 26: sessions keep asking "push as an archive, then delete?" when that is always the right move. c70 fixed our guard; the platform's check still asks.
note: Finding, Oct 26 (coordinator, from the Mac merge hand): after pushing archive/ copies of the c53 probe branches, the branch deletes were refused by Claude Code's built-in auto-mode safety check ("Git Destructive"), not by our guard, so you were asked again. c70 (a refusal with one lossless fix hands the session that fix) and rule shared-trees-archive-then-delete cover only our guard. Fix to find, one cloud lane, needs no answer from you: an allow rule or auto-mode guidance in the installed settings, so a branch delete counts as lossless once an archive/<branch> push at the same tip succeeded, or the branch is contained in main. First check: what auto-mode settings Claude Code reads today (docs, not memory). Port: yes, it ships through the install to every repo. Placed ahead of o13 (triage, Oct 26): the same gripe as c70, and it fires on every Mac cleanup.
